description:
## Goal

Make `ExecutableFacts(E)` one authoritative direct fact owned by `World` and
published by the scheduler. Delete its request-local product identity.

`ExecutableFacts(E)` is the immutable executable-scoped projection shared by
runtime-demand, outgoing-input, transport, and artifact derivation. Those
consumers must read one value rather than independently cloning or reconstructing
activation analysis, lowered body, entry dispatch, callsite summaries, origins,
and executable-need projections.

## Current ground

At `a3a9761d1209165e5230625b9347cf6b0ad09b83`:

- `ExecutableFacts(E)` is still `ProductKey::ExecutableFacts` /
  `ProductValue::ExecutableFacts` in `ProductMemo`.
- `produce_executable_facts_product` already records the correct settled semantic
  inputs: `ActivationAnalyzed(A)`, `LoweredBody(F)`, `EntryDispatch(F)`, and
  every `CallSiteSummary(A, callsite)` named by the settled analysis.
- Runtime demand, outgoing-input edges, and transport read that product.
- `MaterializedExecutable(E)` separately reads and reconstructs overlapping
  analysis/body/callsite state.
- Production root drives create a fresh `PullSession`; the persistent authority
  across drives is `World`, not a root product session.
- `fz-kdt.34` is complete, so public job/fact causality is available for the
  acceptance trace.

## Output contract

- Add exactly one `FactKey::ExecutableFacts(ExecutableKey)` identity.
- Add exactly one scheduler producer job,
  `Job::DeriveExecutableFacts(ExecutableKey)`, and map the fact to that producer
  in `World::demand_fact_producer`.
- Store the value in one `World`-owned map keyed by `ExecutableKey`.
- Keep the value type and pure projection outside the product driver/job module;
  `World` must not depend on `ProductMemo` or a product producer to represent
  semantic truth.
- The producer records settled reads of exactly:
  - `ActivationAnalyzed(E.activation)`
  - `LoweredBody(E.activation.function)`
  - `EntryDispatch(E.activation.function)`
  - every `CallSiteSummary` listed by the settled activation analysis
- Runtime demand, outgoing-input, transport, callable-construction, and
  materialization read the settled direct fact and then obtain the value from
  `World`.
- `MaterializedExecutable(E)` may continue to read `ReturnType(E.activation)`
  separately, but it must not reconstruct the analysis/body/callsite projection
  already carried by `ExecutableFacts(E)`.
- Product consumers record
  `FactUse::settled(FactKey::ExecutableFacts(E))` in their ordinary
  `ProductDependencies`; no fact-to-product bridge or duplicate memo entry is
  introduced.
- A callsite-summary movement invalidates every demanded
  `ExecutableFacts(E)` cell that actually recorded that summary. If multiple
  `ExecutableNeed` keys share the activation, each exact reader moves; unrelated
  executable keys and roots remain standing.
- Equal reproduction preserves the fact's content revision and causes no
  `Current`/content wake. A `Settled` waiter may wake when readiness changes
  dirty→settled, as required by scheduler semantics; that readiness wake must
  not manufacture a content revision or downstream product generation change.
- Scheduler jobs never read `ProductMemo`, and product producers never publish
  or cache a second `ExecutableFacts` value.

## Strategy and TDD

1. Add a production-path telemetry test that observes the existing
   `executable_facts` product and the exact semantic dependencies it records.
2. Add red direct-fact tests for:
   - one fact key, one producer identity, and one World value per
     `ExecutableKey`;
   - the exact settled read set;
   - product consumers waiting on `ExecutableFacts(E)` as a fact, never as a
     product;
   - materialization consuming the shared projection rather than reconstructing
     it.
3. Extract the value/projection into an executable-facts module, add the World
   store/accessor, then add `Job::DeriveExecutableFacts` and
   `FactKey::ExecutableFacts`.
4. Repoint runtime-demand, outgoing-input, transport, callable-construction, and
   materialized-artifact consumers.
5. Delete the product identity and its producer/reader/driver branches.
6. Exercise movement:
   - move one callsite summary and prove only its exact `ExecutableFacts`
     readers and descendants become stale;
   - redefine a function unreachable from a selected root and prove no
     `ExecutableFacts` cell in that root's demanded executable set moves;
   - repeat on the same `World` across root drives, without assuming a persistent
     production `PullSession`.
7. Exercise equal reproduction:
   - content revision remains unchanged;
   - no `Current` reader is woken;
   - any settled-readiness wake is classified as readiness-only;
   - descendant product generations remain unchanged when their final recorded
     dependency state and value are equal.

## Telemetry acceptance

Use `fz.compiler2.work_graph.applied` as the publication and causality authority.

- Every non-initial `DeriveExecutableFacts(E)` evaluation names an exact moved
  semantic dependency.
- Every conclusion reports whether `ExecutableFacts(E)` changed; equal
  conclusions retain the prior revision.
- Initial producer identities correspond one-for-one with exact demanded
  `ExecutableFacts(E)` keys that conclude. Changed re-publications are allowed
  and counted separately; total publication count is not required to equal
  distinct executable inventory.
- No public product event has `product.kind == "executable_facts"`:
  no settlement, displacement, cache hit, or re-entry.
- No root scan or unsanctioned work start is introduced.
- Same-World edit traces and cross-process causal multisets remain deterministic.

## Required deletions

- `ProductKey::ExecutableFacts`
- `ProductValue::ExecutableFacts`
- `produce_executable_facts_product`
- product-form `read_executable_facts`
- `settled_executable_facts` product-memo peeks and mock producer branches
- product-driver dispatch for executable facts
- duplicate analysis/body/callsite reconstruction in artifact materialization
- obsolete product documentation and temporary comparison scaffolding

## Checks and documentation

Run:

- focused fact-table, scheduler, ProductMemo invalidation, runtime-demand,
  transport, callable-construction, and materialization tests;
- same-World edit and unreachable-redefinition tests;
- target fixtures through `interp`, `run`, and `build`;
- the full library suite and single-threaded fixture matrix;
- clippy with warnings denied.

Update in the same change:

- `.agent/docs/fact-engine.md`
- `.agent/docs/pipeline.md`
- `.agent/docs/semantic-fixpoint.md`
- `.agent/docs/performance-instrumentation.md`
- `.agent/docs/telemetry.md`
- `northstar.html`

Document `ExecutableFacts(E)` in the direct-fact vocabulary, its exact producer
and settled inputs, its World-owned value, its product-reader boundary, and the
difference between content stability and settled-readiness wakes.
title: Publish ExecutableFacts(E) as one World-owned scheduler fact and remove its product identity
